Content.SourceString: 想不想看塔吉多跳脚的样子？那模样别提多滑稽了。
Content.LocalizedString: Wanna see Taygedo hopping mad? It's absolutely hilarious.

Content.SourceString: 怎么回事？
Content.LocalizedString: What's going on?

Content.SourceString: 快过来，有好戏看！
Content.LocalizedString: Hurry over here! You don't wanna miss this!

Content.SourceString: 快过来，有好戏看！
Content.LocalizedString: Hurry over here! You don't wanna miss this!

Content.SourceString: 或许你知不知道
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe you would know

Content.SourceString: 知道什么？
Content.LocalizedString: Know what?

Content.SourceString: 我不知道
Content.LocalizedString: I don't know

Content.SourceString: 等下，我还在打字！
Content.LocalizedString: Wait! I'm still typing!

Content.SourceString: 有没有什么味道比较好的东西，是，有牛奶成分的？
Content.LocalizedString: You know anything tasty that is made of milk?

Content.SourceString: 其实要长高的话，不是非得喝牛奶的……
Content.LocalizedString: You don't necessarily need to drink milk to grow taller…

Content.SourceString: 什么啊！我可没说要喝这个长高！
Content.LocalizedString: What?! I never said I wanted to drink that to grow taller!

Content.SourceString: 只是之前打折时候买的奶快过期了，得想办法消耗掉
Content.LocalizedString: I just bought some milk on sale, and it's about to expire. Need to use it up somehow…

Content.SourceString: 比如甜品？很多甜品里就含有牛奶。
Content.LocalizedString: Like desserts? Many desserts contain milk.

Content.SourceString: 对哦，奶油什么的……但是奶油味道好腻
Content.LocalizedString: Oh right, like cream and stuff… But cream tastes way too rich.

Content.SourceString: 牛奶甜品……搜到了，「烤牛奶」，就用这个把剩下的奶消耗掉好了
Content.LocalizedString: Milk desserts… found it! Baked milk pudding! Perfect for using up all that leftover milk!

Content.SourceString: 要做这个吗？我可以来帮忙。
Content.LocalizedString: Want to make that? I can help you out.

Content.SourceString: 好啊好啊，伊波恩后院见！
Content.LocalizedString: Sure thing! Let's meet at the backyard of Eibon!

Content.SourceString: 好啊好啊，伊波恩后院见！
Content.LocalizedString: Sure thing! Let's meet at the backyard of Eibon!

Content.SourceString: 有空吗
Content.LocalizedString: You free?

Content.SourceString: 怎么了？
Content.LocalizedString: What's wrong?

Content.SourceString: 有事要我帮忙吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Is there something you need help with?

Content.SourceString: 有件事想让你帮个忙……
Content.LocalizedString: There's something I need your help with…

Content.SourceString: 对的对的
Content.LocalizedString: Yeah, yeah!

Content.SourceString: 我这有本散架的书，得把它重新拼起来
Content.LocalizedString: I've got this book that's completely fallen apart, and I need to put it back together.

Content.SourceString: 有的地方我看不太懂，怕顺序错了，所以找你帮个忙
Content.LocalizedString: There are some parts I can't really figure out, and I'm worried I'll get the order wrong, so I thought I'd ask for your help.

Content.SourceString: 没想到你会看书……
Content.LocalizedString: I didn't expect you to be reading books…

Content.SourceString: 是漫画书吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Is it a manga?

Content.SourceString: 我看书怎么了！少看不起人！
Content.LocalizedString: What's wrong with me reading?! Don't look down on me!

Content.SourceString: 不是，漫画书我还能看不懂嘛！
Content.LocalizedString: No way! I can definitely understand a manga!

Content.SourceString: 呃不过现在这个不是我的书
Content.LocalizedString: Uh, but this one isn't actually my book.

Content.SourceString: 是呆子的书
Content.LocalizedString: It's dummy's book.

Content.SourceString: 为什么你要拼埃德嘉的书？
Content.LocalizedString: Why are you putting Edgar's book back together?

Content.SourceString: 哎呀三两句说不清楚你先过来伊波恩门口拐角就是了
Content.LocalizedString: Ugh, it's too complicated to explain! Just come over here first, around the corner from Eibon's entrance!

Content.SourceString: 对了，别让娜娜莉和呆子知道这事！
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, and don't let Nanally or dummy find out about this!

Content.SourceString: 对了，别让娜娜莉和呆子知道这事！
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, and don't let Nanally or dummy find out about this!

Content.SourceString: 你喜欢狗吗
Content.LocalizedString: Do you like dogs?

Content.SourceString: 怎么突然问这个？
Content.LocalizedString: Why are you suddenly asking about that?

Content.SourceString: 呃我在垃圾桶里捡到一条狗
Content.LocalizedString: Uh, I found a dog in the trash can.

Content.SourceString: 啊？
Content.LocalizedString: Huh?

Content.SourceString: 啊什么嘛，就是听到垃圾桶里有动静才发现的
Content.LocalizedString: Oh come on, I just heard some noise coming from the trash can and found it there.

Content.SourceString: 听它一直在里面闹腾就顺手救出来了
Content.LocalizedString: I heard it making a fuss in there, so I just pulled it out.

Content.SourceString: 可能是不小心掉进去的吧
Content.LocalizedString: Probably just fell in by accident.

Content.SourceString: 看起来得帮它找找主人了。
Content.LocalizedString: Looks like we'll need to help find its owner.

Content.SourceString: 要过来一起吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Want to come along?

Content.SourceString: 嗯。给个位置。
Content.LocalizedString: Yeah. Send me the location.

Content.SourceString: 在宠物店边上
Content.LocalizedString: By the pet shop.

Content.SourceString: 在宠物店边上
Content.LocalizedString: By the pet shop.

Content.SourceString: 你今天有没有丢什么东西？
Content.LocalizedString: Did you lose something today?

Content.SourceString: ？.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: ?.jpg

Content.SourceString: 应该是没有，我等等再看下。
Content.LocalizedString: I don't think so, but I'll double-check in a bit.

Content.SourceString: 我丢了5000方斯。
Content.LocalizedString: I lost 5,000 Fons.

Content.SourceString: 那种不会引起注意的小东西就不用考虑了
Content.LocalizedString: I'm not talking about some little trinket nobody would notice.

Content.SourceString: 你怎么不说你丢了50000000000方斯？
Content.LocalizedString: Why not just say you lost 50 billion Fons while you're at it?

Content.SourceString: 抡鬼郎丸.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: swingingkiroumaru.jpg

Content.SourceString: 是鬼郎丸啦，它今天一直叫肚子难受，吐也吐不出来
Content.LocalizedString: It's Kiroumaru! He's been complaining about a stomachache all day, but he can't even throw up properly.

Content.SourceString: 摸了下感觉肚子涨涨的，不知道吃了些啥东西
Content.LocalizedString: I felt his tummy and it's all bloated. Who knows what he ate.

OptionText.LocalizedString: How did you do that before?

Content.SourceString: 原来摸得出来吗……
Content.LocalizedString: So you can actually feel it…

Content.SourceString: 之前应该有类似的情况吧，怎么解决的？
Content.LocalizedString: Has something like this happened before? How did you handle it?

Content.SourceString: 摸多了就知道了
Content.LocalizedString: You'll figure it out if you pet him enough!

Content.SourceString: 一般来说，出现这种情况只要给一脚就好了
Content.LocalizedString: Usually when this happens, all it takes is a good kick to sort him out.

Content.SourceString: 不过前几天鬼郎丸又这样，原本以为没什么，谁知道那一脚下去……
Content.LocalizedString: But a few days ago, Kiroumaru was like this again. I thought it was no big deal, but when I gave him that kick…

Content.SourceString: 呃，你没丢东西就好，我再问问别人！
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, good thing you didn't lose anything. I'll go ask someone else!

Content.SourceString: 总之现在我不搞清楚它吃了什么，绝对不会帮它催吐！
Content.LocalizedString: Anyway, I am absolutely NOT helping him vomit until I figure out what he ate!

Content.SourceString: 当鬼郎丸的主人真是辛苦了……
Content.LocalizedString: Being Kiroumaru's owner must be quite a challenge…

Content.SourceString: 你说
Content.LocalizedString: Your turn

Content.SourceString: 我说
Content.LocalizedString: My turn

Content.SourceString: 有什么需要我帮忙的吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Is there anything I can help you with?

Content.SourceString: 你怎么天天盯着手机看的？
Content.LocalizedString: Why are you always glued to your phone like that?

Content.SourceString: 无语.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: speechless.jpg

Content.SourceString: 你都发了这么久了……
Content.LocalizedString: You've been texting for so long…

Content.SourceString: 呃，其实我就是想问问你，有什么能快点长高的办法
Content.LocalizedString: Uh, actually I just wanted to ask if you know any ways to grow taller faster

Content.SourceString: 不准跟别人说！
Content.LocalizedString: Don't tell ANYONE about this!

Content.SourceString: 多喝牛奶？
Content.LocalizedString: Drink more milk?

Content.SourceString: 生活健康规律的话，对长身体更有帮助。
Content.LocalizedString: Maintaining a healthy and regular lifestyle is more beneficial for growth.

Content.SourceString: 许愿
Content.LocalizedString: Make a wish

Content.SourceString: 你怎么跟阿德勒说一样的话？明明一点用都没有！
Content.LocalizedString: Why are you saying the exact same thing as Adler? It's completely useless!

Content.SourceString: 又是什么早睡早起多吃水果蔬菜blablablabla
Content.LocalizedString: Let me guess, "go to bed early, wake up early, eat lots of fruits and vegetables," blah blah blah.

Content.SourceString: 找纳库佩达许愿吗？嗯……没准还真行
Content.LocalizedString: Make a wish to Nacupeda? Hmm… that might actually work.

Content.SourceString: 原来那些瓶子真是你的。
Content.LocalizedString: So those bottles really were yours after all.

Content.SourceString: 我上网搜一下能给我出来一百个这种页面！
Content.LocalizedString: I could Bagel that and get a hundred stupid articles saying the same thing!

Content.SourceString: 不对！那白色的大耗子要真这么灵，海特洛市早就没有矮子和胖子了！
Content.LocalizedString: No way! If that big white rat was really that magical, Hethereau would be a city of perfectly average people ages ago!

Content.SourceString: 抡鬼郎丸.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: swingingkiroumaru.jpg

Content.SourceString: 可恶，难道真的没有办法吗
Content.LocalizedString: Ugh, is there seriously no way to fix this?

Content.SourceString: 抓狂.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: freakingout.jpg

Content.SourceString: 毕竟长高这种事情是急不来的，要不找个同伴一起加油？
Content.LocalizedString: Growing taller isn't something you can rush. Maybe you could find someone to work on it together?

Content.SourceString: 埃德嘉会不会有类似的烦恼？
Content.LocalizedString: I wonder if Edgar has similar worries?

Content.SourceString: 去问呆子吗……他应该也会想长高吧
Content.LocalizedString: Ask that dummy… he probably wants to grow taller too, right?

Content.SourceString: 但这样岂不是又要多一个人知道了……
Content.LocalizedString: But then another person would know about my problem…

Content.SourceString: 总觉得……早雾想要长高已经是全伊波恩都知道的秘密了……
Content.LocalizedString: I have a feeling… Sakiri's desire to grow taller is already Eibon's worst-kept secret…

Content.SourceString: 不可能，绝对不可能！
Content.LocalizedString: No way, absolutely impossible!

Content.SourceString: 抡鬼郎丸.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: swingingkiroumaru.jpg

Content.SourceString: 你觉得有没有一种可能
Content.LocalizedString: Just wondering if there's a possibility…

Content.SourceString: 没有。
Content.LocalizedString: No.

Content.SourceString: 什么可能？
Content.LocalizedString: What possibility?

Content.SourceString: 我还没说呢！
Content.LocalizedString: I haven't even said anything yet!

Content.SourceString: 抡鬼郎丸.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: swingingkiroumaru.jpg

Content.SourceString: 能不能给鬼郎丸也搞一个市民证，然后我就不用管它了
Content.LocalizedString: Could we get Kiroumaru his own Citizen ID? Then I wouldn't have to babysit him anymore.

Content.SourceString: 这样不管他吃什么都不会赖到我头上，多轻松~
Content.LocalizedString: That way whatever he eats won't be my problem anymore. So much easier.

Content.SourceString: 按照《海特洛市治安管理条例》，遗弃宠物者需缴纳……
Content.LocalizedString: According to the "Hethereau Public Safety Ordinance", abandoning a pet would result in a fine of…

Content.SourceString: 按照鬼郎丸的智力，它有可能通过测试拿到市民证，但是感觉它拿到市民证不太可能。
Content.LocalizedString: Given Kiroumaru's intelligence, he might be able to pass the test and get a Citizen ID, but I seriously doubt that would ever actually happen.

Content.SourceString: 怎么忽然不想要鬼郎丸了？
Content.LocalizedString: Why the sudden desire to get rid of Kiroumaru?

Content.SourceString: 不是，鬼郎丸真算得上宠物吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Wait, does Kiroumaru even count as a pet in the first place?

Content.SourceString: 叽里咕噜说啥废话呢
Content.LocalizedString: Bah bah bah bah bah bah bah bah bah.

Content.SourceString: 还不是这家伙一直添麻烦
Content.LocalizedString: It's because this guy keeps causing trouble!

Content.SourceString: 谁想要我卖给他！
Content.LocalizedString: Who said I'm selling him to anyone?!

Content.SourceString: 呃，不过确实，鬼郎丸不太可能通过测试……
Content.LocalizedString: Ugh, but yeah, Kiroumaru probably wouldn't pass the test anyway…

Content.SourceString: 上周跟娜娜莉和呆子接了个委托，到委托人家里了解情况，结果一眼没看住它就把委托人家的马桶盖子吃了
Content.LocalizedString: Last week, I took a commission with Nanally and that dummy. When we went to the client's house to get details, I took my eyes off him for one second and he ate their toilet seat!

Content.SourceString: 真是的，你就不能变成个高智能歧骸吗！
Content.LocalizedString: Geez, why can't you just evolve into a high-intelligence oddity already?!

Content.SourceString: ？.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: ?.jpg

Content.SourceString: 委托人甚至怀疑了自己家的马桶是不是异象，都没有怀疑是不是被什么东西吃掉了
Content.LocalizedString: The client even suspected their toilet might be some kind of anomaly, it never crossed their mind that something might have eaten it!
Uh…

Content.SourceString: 毕竟鬼郎丸是你的异能召唤出来的，也没办法说不要就不要。
Content.LocalizedString: After all, Kiroumaru was summoned by your ability… it's not like you can just dont-want him whenever you want.

Content.SourceString: 叹气.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: sigh.jpg

Content.SourceString: 不搞市民证也行，这家伙能不能再进化一下，把吃下去的东西都消化了
Content.LocalizedString: Forget the Citizen ID. I just wish he could evolve to actually digest the stuff he swallows instead!

Content.SourceString: 这样，它再吃点啥也没人知道了
Content.LocalizedString: That way, no one would ever know when he eats something he shouldn't!

Content.SourceString: 阴笑.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: evilgrin.jpg

Content.SourceString: 总感觉真的出现这种情况的话，先发狂的是浔……
Content.LocalizedString: I have a feeling that if that ever happened, Hotori would be the first one to lose her mind…

Content.SourceString: 哼哼，酒鬼应得的！
Content.LocalizedString: Hehe, serves that drunk right!

Content.SourceString: 问你个事，不准跟别人说
Content.LocalizedString: Hey, gotta ask you something. Don't tell any.

Content.SourceString: 抡鬼郎丸.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: swingingkiroumaru.jpg

Content.SourceString: 我不告诉别人，什么事？
Content.LocalizedString: I won't tell anyone, what's up?

Content.SourceString: 放心，我不会跟别人说你偷偷喝牛奶的事情的。
Content.LocalizedString: Don't worry, I won't tell anyone about your secret milk drinking habits.

Content.SourceString: 不错，很上道嘛
Content.LocalizedString: Not bad, you catch on quick.

Content.SourceString: 谁问你这个了？
Content.LocalizedString: Who asked you about that?

Content.SourceString: 呸！谁说我偷偷喝牛奶了？
Content.LocalizedString: Pfft! Who said I secretly drink milk?!

Content.SourceString: 呸！谁说我偷偷喝牛奶了？
Content.LocalizedString: Pfft! Who said I secretly drink milk?!

Content.SourceString: 总之你不准乱说，我直接问了
Content.LocalizedString: Anyway, just keep your mouth shut. I'll get straight to the point.

Content.SourceString: 你来伊波恩也这么久了，感觉这怎么样啊？
Content.LocalizedString: You've been in Eibon for a while now. How's it treating you?

Content.SourceString: 怎么忽然问这种问题？
Content.LocalizedString: Why are you asking this out of nowhere?

Content.SourceString: 管那么多，问你你说就完了！
Content.LocalizedString: Never mind all that! Just answer the damn question!

Content.SourceString: 反正就是觉得阿德勒怎么样娜娜莉怎么样塔吉多怎么样什么的
Content.LocalizedString: I just wanna know what you think about Adler, Nanally, Taygedo, and all that stuff.

Content.SourceString: 嗯……阿德勒先生总是考虑的很周到，十分体贴，每天早上准备的早餐也非常美味
Content.LocalizedString: Hmm… Adler is always so thoughtful and considerate. The breakfast he prepares every morning is absolutely delicious too.

Content.SourceString: 虽然娜娜莉天天总会有些奇奇怪怪的想法，不过，跟她一起「建设柯林斯家族」也很有趣就是了。
Content.LocalizedString: Even though Nanally always has her share of weird ideas, I have to admit that building the Colucci Family with her is actually pretty fun.

Content.SourceString: 虽然平时看起来蠢蠢的，不过没有塔吉多的话，感觉伊波恩会无聊很多。
Content.LocalizedString: Even though Taygedo seems a bit silly sometimes, I feel like Eibon would be much more boring without him around.

Content.SourceString: 那毕竟整个伊波恩里，想要找个靠谱的人也就只剩下阿德勒了
Content.LocalizedString: I mean, in all of Eibon, Adler's pretty much the only reliable person left anyway.

Content.SourceString: 呃，这么说也不错，跟她跑来跑去确实挺好玩的……
Content.LocalizedString: Uh, I guess you're right. Running around with her is actually pretty fun…

Content.SourceString: 倒也是，虽然经常被浔说两句就过来找我麻烦
Content.LocalizedString: Yeah, I guess so. Though that Hotori's always saying stuff that sends him running to bother me instead.

Content.SourceString: 嘁，我看他也没那么靠谱，还骗我喝牛奶！
Content.LocalizedString: Tch, I don't think he's all that reliable. He even tricked me into drinking milk!

Content.SourceString: 啧，还是你跟娜娜莉待得时间太短了，时间长就觉得累了
Content.LocalizedString: Tch, you've just not spent enough time with Nanally yet. Trust me, hang around her long enough and you'll get tired of it.

Content.SourceString: 唉，分不清谁是老大的笨海獭！
Content.LocalizedString: Ugh, that stupid otter can't even figure out who's in charge!

Content.SourceString: ……没什么！
Content.LocalizedString: …Nevermind!

Content.SourceString: 仔细一想，怎么谁都有这样那样的毛病？
Content.LocalizedString: Come to think of it, why does everyone have some kind of problem or another?

Content.SourceString: 虽然大家都有这样那样的毛病，但伊波恩是个很棒的地方，不是吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Everyone has their quirks, but Eibon is a wonderful place, isn't it?

Content.SourceString: 这么说，你还挺喜欢伊波恩的？
Content.LocalizedString: So you actually like Eibon, huh?

OptionText.LocalizedString: Don't you like it here, Sakiri?

Content.SourceString: 当然了，难道早雾不喜欢吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Of course I do. Don't you like it here too, Sakiri?

Content.SourceString: 所以，今天怎么忽然问这个？
Content.LocalizedString: So, why are you suddenly asking me about this today?

Content.SourceString: 这个，那毕竟我也在这待了这么久了，喜欢不喜欢的，无所谓，无所谓的
Content.LocalizedString: Well, I've been stuck here for so long already. Like it or not, whatever, it doesn't matter. Really doesn't matter at all.

Content.SourceString: （正在编辑中……）
Content.LocalizedString: (Editing…)

Content.SourceString: 真麻烦，就是想问，不行嘛？
Content.LocalizedString: Ugh, what's the big deal? Can't I just ask a simple question?

Content.SourceString: 所以说，伊波恩的大家都有这样那样的毛病。
Content.LocalizedString: So basically, everyone in Eibon has their own particular quirks.

Content.SourceString: 摊手.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: shrugging.jpg

Content.SourceString: 要你多嘴！
Content.LocalizedString: Mind your own business!

Content.SourceString: 抡鬼郎丸.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: swingingkiroumaru.jpg

Content.SourceString: 你有见到塔吉多吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Have you seen Taygedo anywhere?

Content.SourceString: 你被我追杀.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: imcomingforyou.jpg

Content.SourceString: 没有，找他有事吗？
Content.LocalizedString: No, I haven't. Did you need something from him?

Content.SourceString: 偶尔也放过塔吉多一下，不要天天欺负他吧……
Content.LocalizedString: Give Taygedo a break once in a while, would you? You don't have to pick on him every day…

Content.SourceString: 哼，还不是他上次找我们帮忙？
Content.LocalizedString: Hmph, isn't he the one who asked us for help last time?

Content.SourceString: 什么叫我欺负他，这次可是他请我们做事！
Content.LocalizedString: What do you mean I'm picking on him? He's the one who asked us for help this time!

Content.SourceString: 搞了半天，不仅在大街上陪娜娜莉演戏，还被抓着去清理那臭橡皮泥！
Content.LocalizedString: Unbelievable! Not only did I have to put on some stupid show with Nanally in the middle of the street, but then I got dragged into cleaning up that disgusting dough!

Content.SourceString: 鬼郎丸现在嘴里还一股子橡皮泥味，难闻死了！
Content.LocalizedString: Kiroumaru still reeks of that dough! It's absolutely disgusting!

Content.SourceString: 鬼郎丸……这次确实帮了我们很大的忙……
Content.LocalizedString: Kiroumaru… really did help us out a lot this time…

Content.SourceString: 它是吃饱了，塔吉多答应我们的大餐呢！
Content.LocalizedString: He's well-fed because Taygedo promised us a feast! Where is it?!

OptionText.LocalizedString: There must be a reason for this.

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多最后的情况你也知道，应该只是太伤心忘记了吧。
Content.LocalizedString: You know how Taygedo was at the end. He was probably just too heartbroken to remember.

Content.SourceString: 说得对，答应好的事情当然要兑现。
Content.LocalizedString: You're right. If you make a promise, you have to keep it.

Content.SourceString: 不管！答应了我们的，怎么能欠账呢？
Content.LocalizedString: I don't care! He promised us something, so he can't just bail on us!

Content.SourceString: 我也帮了塔吉多那么多，这顿饭得有我一份吧？
Content.LocalizedString: I've helped Taygedo so much too, shouldn't I get a share of this meal?

Content.SourceString: 坏笑.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: evilgrin.jpg

Content.SourceString: 这样的话就达成一致了
Content.LocalizedString: Then it's settled!

Content.SourceString: 虽然塔吉多可能不记得了，但
Content.LocalizedString: Even if Taygedo doesn't remember his promise…

Content.SourceString: 呃，娜娜莉怎么说的来着？哦，「柯林斯家族永不遗忘」！
Content.LocalizedString: Uh, what was it Nanally said again? Oh right, "The Coluccis never forget!"

Content.SourceString: 推眼镜.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: adjustingglasses.jpg

Content.SourceString: 既然他不主动给，我们就只能上门讨债咯~
Content.LocalizedString: If he won't come to us with what he owes, then we'll just have to collect the debt ourselves.
